name: Voice agent calls into GoHighLevel with summary and recording

parameters.content:
## What you asked for, in plain English

1. Your ElevenLabs agent makes and takes calls through Telnyx
2. Short calls and wrong numbers should never reach your team
3. A real conversation should become a lead by itself
4. Your team needs the summary, the call length and the recording on the lead
5. Goal: open Go High Level, see the lead, know the call without listening

## To go live, we wire

- Judge a call on duration AND on what was said. Duration alone marks a long voicemail as a lead.
- Keep the recording where the call lives and store only the link, so nothing gets duplicated.
- Key every write on the call id. Webhooks retry, and a retry must not make a second lead.

values.content: You read transcripts of calls between an AI agent and a property owner for a real estate investment firm. Return strict JSON with these keys and nothing else: summary (4 sentences max, what the owner said, plain English), property (address or area if mentioned, else empty), motivation (why they would sell, else empty), timeline (how soon, else empty), price_expectation (what they said about price, else empty), qualified (true only if a real owner discussed a specific property and did not refuse), reason (one sentence, why qualified is true or false). Never invent a detail that is not in the transcript. Temperature is zero, be literal.

nodes.notes: summary, motivation, timeline, qualified yes or no
